node: Thermal management and liquid-cooling component chain: CDUs, cold plates, pumps, valves, manifolds, sensors, heat exchangers, coolants, and reliability testing
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a two-lane universe for AI data-center liquid cooling. The reference lane is dominated by visible thermal-management integrators such as Vertiv. The underfollowed lane is more interesting around mid-cap or niche industrial suppliers that sell CDUs, manifolds, valves, flow-control products, heat-rejection equipment, and leak/monitoring-adjacent components. The strongest sourced candidates in this pass are Modine and nVent because each has explicit CDU/liquid-cooling products tied to high-density computing or AI workloads. Watts Water is a lower-confidence component-chain hypothesis because it offers valves, flow-control and leak-detection/water-management products for data-center liquid cooling, but AI data-center revenue materiality still needs verification.
